incidents.name: X319 unprotected claimEther()
incidents.notes: claimEther(address,uint256) has no access control, so the attacker called it from a throwaway contract constructor and sent 20.85 BNB of the contract's balance to itself.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xedd632eaf3b57e100ae9142e8ed1641e5fd6b2c0 created 2024-11-09T09:38:20Z by 0x01785130a07a8dd935271535fd7e512986c5dc5e, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xe60329a82c5add1898ba273fc53835ac7e6fd5ca; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
